body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A uses English word 'Hiking' in concept but not literally; more critically, Card A says 'అక్కడ నడక చేయొచ్చు' which is stiff and merely states you can walk there, while Card B gives a warm, natural reason they'd enjoy it ('ప్రకృతి మధ్యలో కాస్త నడవడానికి మీకు చాలా బాగుంటుంది') in neighborly coastal Andhra style. Card A's 'నడవండి' as bare instruction is less respectful than B's explanatory tone; both keep names exact
